query.comment: SAFETY: whenever the hand touches the arm, the arm is fully stopped. Every hand motion, every dropout/flicker pattern.
Sanity: the hand can actually reach the arm.
Liveness sanity: after a full stop the arm can get back to full speed.

query.formula: E<> (age >= 15 and mode == MOV and zone == CLEAR)
query.comment: No needless stops: 165 ms (5 ticks) into a dropout, with the hand far, the arm can still be moving at full speed with the zone clear.
